summary: Frontend-only regression sweep after the app-wide Linear-style redesign (dark #111, violet #8184C4, flat/dense, 4-6px radii, no shadows/gradients). Verified: marketing landing, /login password flow, /app dashboard, /app/connect, /app/activity, /settings, /faq, and /project/{id} (ProjectMemory) all render cleanly with the new dark flat theme. NO console errors, NO pageerrors, NO blank/white surfaces, NO broken layouts observed. Sidebar navigation (Dashboard/Activity/Connect Work/Settings/FAQ) all resolve. ProjectMemory: Overview + all 6 category pills (Deliverables/Scope/Timeline/Requirements/Decisions/Deadlines) render, Decisions table shows 2 rows, Columns menu opens, Views dropdown opens, density-compact and density-comfortable toggles present and clickable. Connect Work: page renders; demo account has no CONNECTED providers on the workspace-scoped page, so the live overlap could not be observed in-browser — verified by code review that ConnectWork.jsx AppCard now uses flex-col with Disconnect in a bordered footer row (borderTop hairline, data-testid connect-disconnect-{key}), so it is structurally impossible for Disconnect to overlap the CONNECTED chip.

issues: Could not visually verify the Disconnect-vs-CONNECTED chip fix because demo account has no connected providers on this page. Code review confirms the fix (flex-col card + bordered footer for Disconnect).

action_items: OPTIONAL: To enable visual regression on the Connect Work disconnect fix, seed the demo account with at least one CONNECTED provider (Gmail or Slack) on the workspace-level connections list so /app/connect renders a CONNECTED card. Right now only project-scoped connected sources are populated, which aren't the same UI.
critical_code_review_comments: ConnectWork.jsx AppCard fix is correct: card is flex-col, top block is a button containing icon + Chip + label/desc, and a sibling footer div with borderTop hairline contains the Disconnect button — no absolute positioning, no possibility of overlap. data-testid connect-disconnect-{key} is present.

ProjectMemory.jsx pill tabs use data-testid project-memory-pill-{key} where key is SINGULAR (deliverable/scope/timeline/requirement/decision/deadline). External tests written against plural keys will fail — must use singular.

Views dropdown and Columns menu use a full-viewport click-catcher div (fixed inset-0 z-30). Expected UX (click-outside-to-close) but can trip Playwright clicks on other elements right after; close via Escape or trigger click before next interaction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign regression pass complete. All tested routes render correctly with zero console/page errors. Connect Work disconnect fix could not be visually observed live (demo has no workspace-level connected providers) but is correct by construction in ConnectWork.jsx lines 32-88. ProjectMemory tabs use singular category keys in testids (project-memory-pill-decision, not -decisions).
